derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5117 (τόπος);
def: out of place, i.e. (figuratively) improper, injurious, wicked

occurrences.text: Howbeit they looked when he should have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.
And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
